name: Mintleaf
summary: A family budget app with cash envelopes that fill and drain, and a safe to spend today dial
about: A nine-page budgeting app for the Harlows, a young family of four. Each spending envelope holds paper notes that slide down into the pocket as money is spent and rise again when you top it up, and a dial on the overview says how much is safe to spend today. Accounts, a bills calendar, goals with photos, transactions with rules, net worth, reports and settings all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Open a page from the top bar: Overview, Accounts, Envelopes, Bills, Goals, Transactions, Net worth, Reports or Settings
Add spending and watch the envelope drain and the safe to spend dial drop; slide What if to test a purchase first
On Envelopes, top up, move money or cover the gaps, filter and sort, and click an envelope for its details
Click a bill on the calendar to mark it paid or switch autopay, or add a bill on any day
Drag a goal's monthly slider to see the finish date move, then add money to it
Sort new payments with rules, change a payment's envelope, or export the month as CSV
Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, and reset the demo data in Settings
